name: Reflection
source:
Talk to an entity about your life before you die. Find out why you died and understand why it happened. Reflect on the life you had as you pass on.

[From [url=https://astroplxnts.itch.io/refection]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与一个神秘存在聊聊你生前的人生。查明自己为何死亡，理解这一切发生的原因。在走向彼岸时，回望自己曾经度过的一生。

[摘自[url=https://astroplxnts.itch.io/refection]Itch.io[/url]]
